title: New insights on interpersonal violence in the Late Pleistocene based on the Nile valley cemetery of Jebel Sahaba (Crèvecoeur and others, 2021)

source.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the PDF and on the Nature page)

summary: Reanalyses the 61 people buried in the Jebel Sahaba cemetery in the Nile Valley, at the end of the Late Pleistocene, to date and describe the violence they suffered. Evidence for what organised conflict looked like in the world just before and around Plato's date.
